entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns', 'Technical Support', or 'Sales'.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I think... I think I need to return it. I'm a bit lost on how to do it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
Yes, the name is Alex Smith, and the order number is... VF77019. I'm sorry, I'm just so confused by all of this. The website was a lot to take in.
No problem at all, Alex, I'm here to help. I see your order right here. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. To be honest, I just... I **changed my mind**. It was a bit of an **impulse buy** for the new year, and I just **don't use it** as much as I thought I would.
I understand completely. Sometimes a new device just doesn't fit into the routine like we expect. Let me just pull up our return policy information for you. One moment please.
Okay, I have your details. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered 17 days ago, is that correct?
That sounds about right. Is that going to be a problem? I thought about trying to **resale** it online but that all seems so complicated. Can't you just help me?

You don't need to worry about that at all. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that window, so I can process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? The full amount? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much!

It's my pleasure. And I see here that you're a VIP member with us, Alex. As a thank you for your loyalty, I'm going to go ahead and waive the return shipping fee. I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that is amazing. You've made this whole process so easy. Thank you, Diana.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
Alright. Have a wonderful day and a Happy New Year! Thank you for calling VeloFit.
